title: Genuine test birth ladder
description: Closed declaration of how a bun test file receives a genuine Original process birth: the build bootstrap capabilities of one real repository request, optionally inside the installed Nx tooling scope. Births are tried in order; a birth with `after` is only tried when the previous failure output matches it.

preparation.description: Work done once beneath this birth before the file starts: `target-execution` prepares the inventory of all emitted targets and hands its path and sha256 to the file as SEMIO_TARGET_EXECUTION_INVENTORY_FILE and SEMIO_TARGET_EXECUTION_INVENTORY_SHA256, then verifies that every consumed fact and the producer still hold.
